definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.11) 'Any group item except for' a strongly-typed, bit or national group item; §2023:3.11 also excludes a variable-length group item, which 2002 does not have. The set of 2002 groups that qualify is the same; and the CURSOR clause is declined at 2002 (COBOL1560) whatever data-name-1's description.
